Dates.text: Isaac Newton is born in Woolsthorpe, England.
The first book of the Principia is presented to the Royal Society.
Philosophiae Naturalis Principia Mathematica is published.

Title: Newton's law of gravitation
Body-Text: In his 1687 masterwork, the Principia, Isaac Newton united earthly physics and celestial mechanics under a single universal force: gravity. Attraction grows with mass and weakens with the square of distance. From this, Newton derived Kepler's planetary laws and revealed a cosmos governed by predictable natural laws.
